name: pet-desktop-companion
description: A local-first Windows desktop pet companion with installable pet and item packs, multi-pet interactions, and affinity progression.
author: SharingYu

scripts.check: node --check apps/desktop/electron/main.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/electron/preload.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/electron/petpack-compat.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/main.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/main-v03.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/v03-bootstrap.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/bridge.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/sprite.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/pet-actor.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/pet-world.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/platforms.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/progression.js && node --check apps/desktop/renderer/state.js && node --check tools/itempack/lib.mjs && node --check tools/verify-packaged-shell.mjs && node --check tools/write-release-checksums.mjs && node --check tools/render-marketing.mjs && node --check tools/marketing-video-recorder.cjs && node --check tools/marketing-video-preload.cjs && node --check marketing/video.js && node tools/render-marketing.mjs --check && node --test apps/desktop/electron/test/*.test.mjs apps/desktop/renderer/test/*.test.mjs tools/petpack/test/*.test.mjs tools/itempack/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.pack:win: pnpm check && pnpm build && electron-builder --dir && pnpm verify:package
scripts.dist:win: pnpm check && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis && pnpm verify:package
scripts.dist:portable: pnpm check && pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable -c.win.artifactName=PetDesktop-Portable-${version}-${arch}.${ext} && pnpm verify:package
